plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you add them to your stories.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app accesses your camera to let you take photos and add them to your stories.

plugins.accessPrivileges: The app needs access to your media library to let you add photos to your stories.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: The app needs access to your location to add it into your stories and to keep your memories complete.
